All services available in-person or via concierge. 60 min Consultation Service Consultation for Skin Imperfection - Pigmentation Removal A consultation is available for this service so our specialist can assess your skin tone and recommend the most effective treatment. Pigmentation Removal targets unwanted skin discolorations such as age spots, sunspots, melasma, and hyperpigmentation using advanced electrolysis or energy-based techniques. The treatment works to break down excess melanin deposits, restoring a more even and radiant skin tone. Price for Consultation $250.00 Book Now 60 min Consultation Service Consultation for Scalp Micropigmentation A consultation is available for this service to help you understand the procedure and personalize your treatment plan. Scalp Micropigmentation is a non-surgical cosmetic procedure that uses micro-needles to deposit pigment into the scalp, replicating the natural appearance of hair follicles. It is an effective solution for hair loss, thinning hair, alopecia, and scalp scars, creating the illusion of a fuller, denser head of hair. Price for Consultation $250.00 Book Now 60 min Consultation Service Consultation for Large Cyst Removal A consultation is available for this service so our specialist can evaluate the cyst and determine the safest removal approach. Large Cyst Removal is a clinical procedure to excise or drain a cyst — a closed sac of tissue that may contain fluid, air, or semi-solid material beneath the skin. Treatment is performed under local anesthesia to ensure safe, comfortable, and complete removal with minimal risk of recurrence. How It Works We Come to You Stone IWC was built on a concierge model from day one. We do not wait for you to find us -- we bring our full practice directly to your location with the same professional standards and comprehensive care as our facility. Our practitioners arrive with everything needed for a complete treatment experience. Whether it is a single treatment for one person or a full wellness day for your entire organization, our concierge team handles everything from setup to cleanup. You just show up and receive care.
